message.content:
A structured wool-blend blazer in a deep forest green with sharp shoulders and single-breasted closure, cut slim through the torso for a modern silhouette.
Tailored high-waisted trousers in matching dark emerald felt, featuring a straight leg with slight tapering at the ankle and no pleats.
A fine-gauge cashmere turtleneck sweater in charcoal grey, ribbed at the neck and hem to provide subtle contrast while maintaining warmth against the frost.
Classic pointed-toe leather pumps in black patent finish, heeled moderately at 8 cm for stability on indoor restaurant floors.
Delicate gold-plated drop earrings with small geometric details to catch candlelight without overpowering the festive atmosphere.
A structured clutch in matching forest green with a matte texture, complemented by sheer black tights and a sleek wrap coat in midnight blue wool if stepping outside into the cold air.
This outfit works perfectly for an upscale restaurant New Year's celebration because it balances the requested smart to formal dress code with the season's frosty weather through luxurious fabrics like cashmere and wool that provide essential warmth without bulk. The deep forest green color scheme feels rich and celebratory under dim restaurant lighting while remaining sophisticated enough for a winter event, avoiding overly flashy patterns in favor of textured elegance. Each piece is chosen to respect the need for an outer layer due to the freezing temperatures, ensuring comfort throughout the evening, while the monochromatic base allows the accessories to provide just enough festive sparkle appropriate for the occasion.
